requests.prompt_base: Describe actual visible changes in chronological RGB frames. Bind entities across time. Record at most three persistent changes or reversals and a neutral initial scene context. Robot-only motion, camera movement and occlusion are not automatically environment changes. Do not infer purpose, utility, completion or a task plan. Return only JSON. JSON layer check: coverage occurs exactly once at the top level, alongside context and changes. Never place coverage inside a changes item. Output shape (empty structure, not scene evidence): {"context":"brief scene","changes":[{"b":"earlier supplied ID","a":"later supplied ID","object":"brief object","before":"brief state","after":"brief state"}],"coverage":"complete"}. Exact keys context, changes, coverage. context is one neutral first-scene sentence max 240 characters. changes at most 3 items; exact keys b, a, object, before, after. b and a are supplied evidence IDs, time(b)<time(a). object/before/after each max 160 characters; brief visible descriptions. coverage=complete|overflow|occluded|no_observable_change. Host assigns change numbers and looks up timestamps; do not generate entity IDs or timestamps.

comparison: unchanged compact2 prompt and output contract, replace automatic 8-frame+4-crop policy by all15 legal full frames; unequal pixel budget and natural cost
protocol: Goal-blind automatic HSV saturation/chromatic RGB difference ROI proposals, fixed thresholds and temporal diversity; same dense prompt and all15 fullframes plus <=4 model-focus crops from selected legal past pairs. No manually picked region or goal/label. More visual tokens, not equal compute. Saturation can include wood, shadows and occlusion; does not certify physical motion or object identity. Parent cross47, prior602.
